name: Waply – Click to Chat Widget
author: sattivedevlabs

sections.description:
Waply is the ultimate Click-to-Chat widget for modern WordPress sites. We stripped away the bloat to give you a hyper-fast, deeply customizable floating button that connects your visitors directly to your WhatsApp instantly.

Instead of writing custom CSS, Waply comes with an advanced design engine right out of the box. Whether you want a Glassmorphism popup, a Neo-Brutalism button, or a classic Material Design look, you can match your brand perfectly in seconds.

Key Features

  • 9 Visual Themes: Classic, Material, Dark Mode, Glassmorphism, Neumorphism, Neo-Brutalism, and more.
  • 18 Custom Animations: 9 idle button animations (Pulse, Bounce, Wobble) and 9 typing loaders (Wave, Spinner, Cursor).
  • Smart Business Hours: Automatically hide the widget when you are off the clock so you don’t get messages at 3 AM.
  • Targeting Rules: Show the widget everywhere, or restrict it strictly to your homepage, specific posts, or pages.
  • Custom Avatars & Icons: Upload your own support agent picture and custom chat button icon.
  • Zero Impact on Page Speed: Built with vanilla JS and optimized CSS.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the waply-click-to-chat-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Waply Chat in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number (with country code), select your theme, and click Save!
sections.faq:
Do I need a WhatsApp Business account to use this?

No! You can use a standard personal WhatsApp number or a WhatsApp Business number. Waply redirects the user seamlessly either way.

Will this slow down my website?

Absolutely not. Waply is built by developers, for developers. It does not rely on heavy frameworks or external libraries. The assets are tiny and highly optimized.

How do I change the time zone for the Business Hours?

Waply automatically inherits your official WordPress time zone. You can configure this in your WordPress dashboard under Settings > General > Timezone.
